data.name: ResetViewButtonTip

data.value: Save view as image: this camera and view style as a PNG, 1024 to 4096 px on the long side, on a transparent background

data.name: ToolbarOpenTip
data.value: Open a photo of an object (PNG, JPEG, WebP) to make a model from, or a 3D model (GLB, OBJ, PLY, STL) to edit. You can also drop the file on the window. (Ctrl+O)

data.name: ToolbarSaveAsTip
data.value: Save the model as GLB, OBJ, PLY or STL (Ctrl+S)

data.name: UndoButtonTip

data.name: RotateXButtonTip
data.value: Turn 90° about the X axis, for a model lying down

data.name: DropTitle
data.value: Drop a photo or a 3D model here

data.name: DropAdvice
data.value: Works best with one whole object, centred, on a plain background. Everything runs on this computer; no photo leaves it.

data.name: GeneratePromptTip
data.value: What to draw, e.g. a wooden chair.

data.name: GenerateTemplate
data.value: {object}, one whole object, centred, three-quarter view from slightly above, soft even studio light, plain light grey background, no text, nothing else in the picture

data.name: GenerateTemplateTip
data.value: {object} is replaced by the object; the rest asks for what a 3D reconstruction works best from.

data.name: ViewerHint
data.value: Drag to turn · mouse wheel to zoom · double-click to recentre

data.name: ObjectCardCaption
data.value: A whole model, with the front, sides and back TripoSR infers from a single photo. Coloured per vertex.

data.name: ObjectThresholdTip
data.value: Lower fattens the object and closes holes; higher thins it and separates parts. 25 is TripoSR's own.

data.name: ObjectRemoveBackgroundTip
data.value: Turn off only for a PNG already cut out, with transparency: that one is used as it is.

data.name: ObjectProjectPhoto
data.value: Sharp photo colours on the front

data.name: ObjectProjectPhotoTip
data.value: TripoSR colours from a 64 × 64 grid; this lays the photo's own colours back on the side it shows.

data.name: ObjectEnhancePhotoTip
data.value: For photos under 1024 px or with noise: upscales 4× with AI before cutting out and reconstructing.

data.name: ObjectEveryPoint
data.value: Sample every grid point (slower, catches thin parts)

data.name: ObjectEveryPointTip
data.value: Evaluates all of the grid instead of about a quarter of it, so sampling takes about 4× as long; thin legs and handles the coarse pass skips are kept.

data.name: ObjectSmoothingTip
data.value: Taubin passes after the surface is drawn; 0 keeps the raw mesh to sculpt from. Each pass is a small share of a run at 256.

data.name: ObjectPiecesTip
data.value: Fragments smaller than this share of the largest part are dropped; 0 keeps every piece. It adds next to nothing to the run's time.

data.name: ReliefCardCaption
data.value: Each pixel's depth (Depth Anything V2) becomes height: a bas-relief textured with the photo. Works with any image: faces, landscapes, buildings.

data.name: ReliefDepthTip
data.value: How far the nearest point stands out, as a share of the width.

data.name: ReliefBaseTip
data.value: With a base the mesh is closed (solid) and can go to a 3D printer. Without one it is only the surface.

data.name: CloudCardCaption
data.value: A textured model from a cloud service, from the open photo or a description. What is sent, and what it costs, is said before it goes.

data.name: CloudTextureTip
data.value: Off gives the bare shape, for less.

data.name: CloudQuadsTip
data.value: Quads rather than triangles, for editing in Blender.

data.name: EditCardCaption
data.value: For the generated model or an opened 3D model. Every step can be undone.

data.name: SimplifyAmountTip
data.value: Fewer triangles: a smaller, lighter file for games, the web and slicers, with the shape kept.

data.name: SubdivideButtonTip
data.value: 4× the triangles, rounded off: a smoother surface for printing large.

data.name: FillHolesButtonTip
data.value: Closes the holes in the mesh, so it is solid (watertight) for printing.

data.name: PiecesButtonTip
data.value: Deletes the loose fragments smaller than this share of the largest part.

data.name: SmoothButtonTip
data.value: Removes jagged edges and noise without shrinking the model (Taubin), in this many passes.

data.name: FlattenButtonTip
data.value: Flattens this share of the model's height from the bottom, so it stands on the printer bed.

data.name: UpscaleTextureButtonTip
data.value: For textured models (reliefs, opened OBJ and GLB): upscales and cleans the texture image, up to 4096 px.

data.name: NewTextureButtonTip
data.value: Draws a seamless material (wood, stone, painted metal) and puts it on the model's surface.

data.name: NewTexturePromptTip
data.value: For example: weathered grey stone, oak planks, red painted metal.

data.name: ReprojectButtonTip
data.value: Puts the photo's sharp colours back on the front of the object, for example after subdividing.

data.name: CloudRemeshPolycountTip
data.value: 100 to 300,000: the clean mesh's triangle count.

data.name: CloudRetexturePromptTip
data.value: What the new surface looks like, e.g. weathered oak, painted steel.

data.value: Start Blender with this model imported into an empty scene

data.value: On the CPU, FP32 is always used because it is faster there. Models are downloaded from Hugging Face on first use and checked by SHA-256.

data.value: The model shown has not been saved, and restarting loses it and its history. Save it with Save as first, or update anyway.

data.name: AboutAutoUpdateTip
data.value: Asks api.github.com for the latest release, sending only Modelado's name and version.

data.name: CloudServicesCaption
data.value: Optional. With a key, the service's actions appear beside the local ones, and nothing is sent until you agree to it each time.

data.name: ProviderAuto

data.name: ProviderCpuTip
data.value: For a GPU that fails or is slower than the CPU for a model.

data.value: The choice applies to the next operation and is kept for the next start; --provider on the command line still wins for that run.

data.value: The built-in models come first. Add a Hugging Face repository (owner/name) or a manifest URL, and a model it lists for an operation becomes a choice on that operation's card.
